subject: Datatable Column Selection Disabling and Grouping

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Datatable Column Selection Disabling and Grouping
parts:
Is it possible to disable column selection for a few table columns, similar to how it is possible to disable filtering for some columns ?

Also, when there are two or more rows of column headings, can the column selection happen with the outer column headings ? Considering the iris dataset as an example, clicking on Petal would select or deselect both Petal Width and Petal Length columns simultaneously.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Datatable Column Selection Disabling and Grouping
parts:
On Mon, Sep 21, 2015 at 1:00 AM, Dario Strbenac <dario....@gmail.com> wrote:
> Is it possible to disable column selection for a few table columns, similar
> to how it is possible to disable filtering for some columns ?
No, this is not possible currently. Sorry.

>
> Also, when there are two or more rows of column headings, can the column
> selection happen with the outer column headings ? Considering the iris
> dataset as an example, clicking on Petal would select or deselect both Petal
> Width and Petal Length columns simultaneously.

That sounds like an interesting idea, but again, it is not possible at
the moment. Compared to the previous question, this one is more
unlikely to be implemented since a custom table header/footer can be
fairly complex. When you use a custom table container, you are likely
to be on your own (the door is wide open and it is difficult to deal
with all possible scenarios).
